This document is the Cookie Policy for AI Atlas, last updated on June 2, 2025. It explains what cookies are, how AI Atlas uses them, and how users can manage their preferences. The policy details several types of cookies used:

1.  **Essential Cookies:** Necessary for website functionality (Authentication, Security, Session Management, Load Balancing, CSRF Protection).
2.  **Functional Cookies:** Enhance user experience (Preferences, Dashboard Layout, Form Data, Feature Toggles, Timezone).
3.  **Analytics Cookies:** Help understand website usage (Usage Analytics, Performance Monitoring, Feature Usage, A/B Testing, Heat Mapping).
4.  **Marketing Cookies:** Used for advertising (Targeted Advertising, Retargeting, Campaign Tracking, Conversion Tracking, Social Media).

The policy provides detailed information on First-Party Cookies set by AI Atlas, presented in a table format with columns for Name, Purpose, Duration, and Type:

| Name             | Purpose                        | Duration | Type      |
|------------------|--------------------------------|----------|-----------|
| aiatlas_session  | User session management        | Session  | Essential |
| user_preferences | Store user settings and preferences | 1 year   | Functional |
| analytics_id     | Anonymous usage analytics      | 2 years  | Analytics |
| marketing_consent| Track marketing cookie consent | 1 year   | Marketing |

It also lists Third-Party Cookies used, including Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Hotjar, and Intercom, with a brief description of their purpose.

The duration of cookies is explained, including Session Cookies, Persistent Cookies, Secure Cookies, and HttpOnly Cookies.

Users can manage their cookie preferences through a Cookie Consent Banner, browser settings (with instructions for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge), and specific opt-out options for Google Analytics, Google Ads, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

The potential impact of disabling different cookie types is outlined. The policy mentions that updates may occur and will be notified through the website or email, with the 'Last updated' date indicating the latest revision.

Contact information for the AI Atlas Privacy Team is provided via email addresses (privacy@aiatlas.com, cookies@aiatlas.com) and a placeholder for the company address.

The footer includes links to other legal documents (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Data Protection) and company information.
